outcome.Summary: Made stats.Collector safe for concurrent use by adding a sync.RWMutex guarding the counters/samples maps and hooks slice: write locks in Incr, Observe, OnIncr, Reset, Percentile (in-place sort), and read locks in Get, Snapshot; Incr copies hooks under the lock and invokes them after release to avoid deadlock. Verified with `go test -race -count=1 ./...`, which exits 0 with all tests passing.
